8af4c004c438f601f0fe.en: Tricky words have a part you cannot spell just by listening.
8af4c004c438f601f0fe.id: Tricky words punya bagian yang tidak bisa dieja hanya dengan mendengarkan.

de18e35d0e21ad87a75e.en: Find the tricky part. Say the word in a funny way to remember it.
de18e35d0e21ad87a75e.id: Cari bagian yang sulit. Ucapkan kata itu dengan cara lucu supaya kamu ingat.

a22b9e4a67a539a498c4.en: Some words have a silent letter. Climb has a silent b.
a22b9e4a67a539a498c4.id: Ada kata yang punya huruf tanpa bunyi (silent letter). Climb punya b yang tidak berbunyi.

de32585360a85403b916.en: Some words sound the same but mean different things.
de32585360a85403b916.id: Ada kata yang bunyinya sama tetapi artinya berbeda.

ad4bc2697c1da711a64a.en: Use look, say, cover, write and check to practise.
ad4bc2697c1da711a64a.id: Pakai look, say, cover, write, dan check untuk berlatih.

a9c5bddadefeec635a7d.en: People is spelt p, e, o, p, l, e.
a9c5bddadefeec635a7d.id: People dieja p, e, o, p, l, e.

899776b018ce36d217ae.en: People has eo in the middle.

e8c37cd1ad363761d271.en: Because is spelt b, e, c, a, u, s, e.
e8c37cd1ad363761d271.id: Because dieja b, e, c, a, u, s, e.

22c86bddad7f7732c0be.en: This tricky word has au in the middle and ends with se.
22c86bddad7f7732c0be.id: Kata yang sulit ini punya au di tengah dan berakhir dengan se.

4ab14dd36743c37859f9.en: The e at the end is missing.

a30662b4ba36bf01f4d9.en: Could is the past of can. It is a tricky word with oul in the middle.
a30662b4ba36bf01f4d9.id: Could adalah bentuk lampau dari can. Kata ini sulit dieja, dengan oul di tengahnya.

e6b08bc499f031f7c380.en: When I was four is in the past. Can is for now.
e6b08bc499f031f7c380.id: When I was four terjadi di masa lalu. Can dipakai untuk sekarang.

afd9544f43c2b16b663f.en: This is not how we spell it.

cbe2a820293cba6d6255.en: Friend is spelt f, r, ie, n, d.
cbe2a820293cba6d6255.id: Friend dieja f, r, ie, n, d.

f82d908f246d52008525.en: Old is the opposite of young. Cold, gold and hold have the same spelling pattern.
f82d908f246d52008525.id: Old adalah lawan kata dari young. Cold, gold, dan hold punya pola ejaan yang sama.

7d5aa9647d915c159d23.en: Cold is about how hot or cold something is.
7d5aa9647d915c159d23.id: Cold berkaitan dengan seberapa panas atau dingin sesuatu.

38aa5f56ab91512a278c.en: Gold is a shiny yellow metal.
38aa5f56ab91512a278c.id: Gold adalah logam kuning yang berkilau.

46fa50bec6116077a31a.en: Hold means to keep in your hands.

54c9300c1a347827b4f1.en: Would and wood, eye and I, hour and our, one and won sound the same but mean different things.
54c9300c1a347827b4f1.id: Would dan wood, eye dan I, hour dan our, one dan won bunyinya sama, tetapi artinya berbeda.

beb229105dc0a8743328.en: Two is the number 2. To and too sound the same but mean different things.
beb229105dc0a8743328.id: Two adalah bilangan 2. To dan too bunyinya sama, tetapi artinya berbeda.

7cda9e64899ceb8ffb87.en: To is used in: I go to school.
7cda9e64899ceb8ffb87.id: To dipakai dalam: I go to school.

f56d8ed586ec696910b3.en: Too means also, or very much.

a34477b038daf55fac95.en: Tow means to pull a car.

852e4eb41209816909cd.en: Water, again and busy are tricky words. They are spelt in ways you cannot fully hear.
852e4eb41209816909cd.id: Water, again, dan busy adalah kata yang sulit dieja. Ejaannya tidak bisa kamu dengar sepenuhnya dari bunyinya.

bde8be2d2f1ac4898c10.en: Water is spelt w, a, t, e, r.
bde8be2d2f1ac4898c10.id: Water dieja w, a, t, e, r.

6c1093b81095447bc9c2.en: Again has ai: a, g, a, i, n.
6c1093b81095447bc9c2.id: Again punya ai: a, g, a, i, n.

a9df79d99d58db161700.en: Busy is spelt b, u, s, y.
a9df79d99d58db161700.id: Busy dieja b, u, s, y.

3f90bf48a6b4563596ba.en: Hour means 60 minutes. The h is silent, so it sounds like our.
3f90bf48a6b4563596ba.id: Hour berarti 60 menit. Huruf h tidak dibunyikan, jadi bunyinya seperti our.

3e1cd0af18587d529923.en: Climb has a silent b at the end. We write it, but we do not say it.
3e1cd0af18587d529923.id: Climb punya huruf b yang tidak dibunyikan di akhir. Kita menuliskannya, tetapi tidak mengucapkannya.

0109799ad9b3cbe92c6f.en: You can hear every letter in clap.
0109799ad9b3cbe92c6f.id: Kamu bisa mendengar setiap huruf dalam clap.

c9b493cfb57f9876e631.en: You can hear every letter in club.
c9b493cfb57f9876e631.id: Kamu bisa mendengar setiap huruf dalam club.

52cdfc53944b3a3df88b.en: You can hear every letter in clip.
52cdfc53944b3a3df88b.id: Kamu bisa mendengar setiap huruf dalam clip.

64a23b8a9b9c27fd1832.en: Climb has a silent b, knee has a silent k and write has a silent w. You can hear every letter in jump, milk and lamp.
64a23b8a9b9c27fd1832.id: Pada climb, huruf b tidak dibunyikan, pada knee, huruf k tidak dibunyikan, dan pada write, huruf w tidak dibunyikan. Kamu bisa mendengar setiap huruf pada jump, milk, dan lamp.

a4cc106b9e855eaafb8a.en: Who asks about a person. Where asks about a place, when about time and what about a thing.
a4cc106b9e855eaafb8a.id: Who menanyakan orang. Where menanyakan tempat, when menanyakan waktu, dan what menanyakan benda.

27b6a6d5b6f3a932b63d.en: Father means dad. It is spelt f, a, t, h, e, r.
27b6a6d5b6f3a932b63d.id: Father berarti ayah (dad). Kata ini dieja f, a, t, h, e, r.

db4577ea1b954606dc31.en: Many is spelt with an a, children is the plural of child, and we say there are for more than one.
db4577ea1b954606dc31.id: Many dieja dengan huruf a, children adalah bentuk jamak dari child, dan kita memakai there are untuk lebih dari satu.

117b655e09eadb34aa9a.en: Many is spelt m, a, n, y.
117b655e09eadb34aa9a.id: Many dieja m, a, n, y.

25cd3c3a171ac3bae36f.en: More than one child is children.
25cd3c3a171ac3bae36f.id: Lebih dari satu child disebut children.

7b92486d8997c7f597d8.en: For more than one, we use are.
7b92486d8997c7f597d8.id: Untuk lebih dari satu, kita memakai are.

5327c6c51e2b343bf13f.en: Child and wild both have a long i. In will, chill and milk, the i is short.
5327c6c51e2b343bf13f.id: Child dan wild sama-sama punya bunyi i panjang (long i). Pada will, chill, dan milk, bunyi i pendek.

1753b3d5271448311727.en: In great, break and steak, ea makes the long a sound. In speak, ea makes the long e sound.
1753b3d5271448311727.id: Pada great, break, dan steak, ea berbunyi a panjang (long a). Pada speak, ea berbunyi e panjang (long e).

7d457b37695fbc9fe32e.en: Great has the same sound as break and steak.
7d457b37695fbc9fe32e.id: Great punya bunyi yang sama dengan break dan steak.

e4d94c38343e5b4f26cd.en: Break has the same sound as great and steak.
e4d94c38343e5b4f26cd.id: Break punya bunyi yang sama dengan great dan steak.

5b2a53fe620cb44865de.en: Steak has the same sound as great and break.
5b2a53fe620cb44865de.id: Steak punya bunyi yang sama dengan great dan break.

562b64adfd15c376ae4a.en: Frend, sed, shud and agen are wrong. They should be friend, said, should and again.
562b64adfd15c376ae4a.id: Frend, sed, shud, dan agen salah. Seharusnya friend, said, should, dan again.

8d88b30a9caf0c24c7cc.en: My, we and play are spelt correctly.
8d88b30a9caf0c24c7cc.id: My, we, dan play sudah dieja dengan benar.

af4d66b439687ccd0aa0.en: Pretty is spelt p, r, e, t, t, y. It sounds like pritty, but it has an e.
af4d66b439687ccd0aa0.id: Pretty dieja p, r, e, t, t, y. Bunyinya seperti pritty, tetapi ada huruf e.

8a0c058d0ff4bfcd0611.en: The word is because. Remember: big elephants can always understand small elephants.
8a0c058d0ff4bfcd0611.id: Katanya adalah because. Ingat: big elephants can always understand small elephants.

dbda3883235fa2017fb5.en: The word is could. Remember the ending ould from would and should.
dbda3883235fa2017fb5.id: Katanya adalah could. Ingat akhiran ould dari would dan should.

2082ccca25df50781e3b.en: Friend is spelt f - r - i - e - n - d.
2082ccca25df50781e3b.id: Friend dieja f - r - i - e - n - d.

75a4477f6b380b79f522.en: The letters i and e are the wrong way round.

1e5da8fda716d9465fe9.en: The a does not belong here.
1e5da8fda716d9465fe9.id: Huruf a tidak seharusnya ada di sini.

5103be187614de4e2e01.en: Because is spelt b - e - c - a - u - s - e.
5103be187614de4e2e01.id: Because dieja b - e - c - a - u - s - e.

5b4cb619d6bff97063f4.en: The letters are in the wrong order.

e5ada8b9e2d39b2989b3.en: They were at school has all the words spelt right.
e5ada8b9e2d39b2989b3.id: Semua kata pada They were at school ejaannya benar.

bfcd02eeca5905524139.en: Their shows that something belongs to them.
bfcd02eeca5905524139.id: Their menunjukkan bahwa sesuatu milik mereka.

5f62c0ffccb685e79be1.en: They're is short for they are.
5f62c0ffccb685e79be1.id: They're adalah singkatan dari they are.

55ee5d06db12041deb6e.en: We were at the park yesterday.
55ee5d06db12041deb6e.id: We were at the park yesterday.

2d662a24cecd8b97d00e.en: The word is would, a tricky word.
2d662a24cecd8b97d00e.id: Katanya adalah would, kata yang sulit dieja.

32321cc38ca6a739fa6e.en: The word is people, a tricky word.
32321cc38ca6a739fa6e.id: Katanya adalah people, kata yang sulit dieja.

0fdfee99d247610d5473.en: Because, friend and water are spelt right.
0fdfee99d247610d5473.id: Because, friend, dan water ejaannya benar.

79fbe98742eb131cc561.en: To, too and two sound the same but mean different things.
79fbe98742eb131cc561.id: To, too, dan two bunyinya sama, tetapi artinya berbeda.

f7bb220dbf3e48cc0ef6.en: Beautiful is spelt b - e - a - u - t - i - f - u - l.
f7bb220dbf3e48cc0ef6.id: Beautiful dieja b - e - a - u - t - i - f - u - l.

663d52b9b12c169020e5.en: There is only one l at the end.
663d52b9b12c169020e5.id: Di akhir kata hanya ada satu l.

acd983ca09cda1c78167.en: Mango, banana and apple are fruit. A carrot is a vegetable.
acd983ca09cda1c78167.id: Mango, banana, dan apple adalah buah. Carrot adalah sayuran.

a60f9e60ab454c045d7d.en: The word is ball, so the missing letter is a.
a60f9e60ab454c045d7d.id: Katanya adalah ball, jadi huruf yang hilang adalah a.

13ff55b96afb7e9229f6.en: Because has a tricky au in the middle and an e at the end.
13ff55b96afb7e9229f6.id: Because punya au yang sulit di tengah dan huruf e di akhir.

00b10683b76c26cb0529.en: Friend is spelt f-r-i-e-n-d. It has an i before the e.
00b10683b76c26cb0529.id: Friend dieja f-r-i-e-n-d. Ada huruf i sebelum huruf e.

8488dd3c2531c9402716.en: People has eo in the middle and ends with le.
8488dd3c2531c9402716.id: People punya eo di tengah dan diakhiri dengan le.

a9566c0706d70017d4c7.en: Could is spelt c-o-u-l-d. It has an o, a u and a silent l.
a9566c0706d70017d4c7.id: Could dieja c-o-u-l-d. Ada huruf o, huruf u, dan huruf l yang tidak dibunyikan.

1da11630fadd66368136.en: Said has ai in the middle, even though it does not sound like rain.
1da11630fadd66368136.id: Said punya ai di tengah, walaupun bunyinya tidak seperti rain.

89eca2871e498c9e74d6.en: The correct spelling is w-h-i-c-h, with the letter h after w.
89eca2871e498c9e74d6.id: Ejaan yang benar adalah w-h-i-c-h, dengan huruf h setelah w.
